source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.leaves: Two-ranked, usually 8–20 pairs of leaflets, slightly touch-sensitive
morphology_source_reported.petiolar_gland: Sessile or short-stalked, disk-like, ca. 1.5 mm across, near middle of petiole to lower leaflet pair
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Yellow petals; upper four with basal reddish marking; lower petal larger; anthers yellow and/or purple
morphology_source_reported.fruit_length_source_printed: 5–7 mm (suspect printed error; not approved as a species measurement)

habitat_source_reported: Open woods, prairies, disturbed sites, often sandy
cautions: Source prints fruits 5–7 mm long; appears inconsistent with pod morphology; withheld from verified numerical fruit traits pending independent source check
Does not establish Hays County occurrence or nativity; do not export to identification scoring without taxon review
